verdict.rationale: The evidence describes LangGraph's checkpointer/store persistence architecture (Postgres-backed state, threads, long-term memory) but never documents any retention policy, TTL, or explicit deletion/purge API for stored checkpoints or store data. Since LangGraph is self-hosted, developers could in theory manage deletion via their own database, but no first-party or community evidence confirms any built-in data-retention or deletion controls.
